description: This file defines a React component called TasksPage that renders a task management interface. It includes functions for retrieving related data (regionName, engineerName, routeName), status handling, and building comments. The component manages task filtering, selection, and displays task details, exception and status histories, all in a read-only format suitable for a dashboard view.

methods.name: regionName(state, regionId)
methods.description: Returns the name of a region given the state and regionId, or a placeholder if not found.

methods.name: engineerName(state, engineerId)
methods.description: Returns the name of a user (engineer) given the state and engineerId, or a placeholder if not found.

methods.name: routeName(state, routeId)
methods.description: Returns the name of a route given the state and routeId, or a placeholder if not found.

methods.name: toneToBadgeClass(tone)
methods.description: Maps a tone value ('success', 'error', 'warn') to corresponding badge CSS classes.

methods.name: isExceptionStatus(status)
methods.description: Checks if a status code represents an exception status (REJECTED or REDO).

methods.name: buildEngineerCommentsForTask(scopedState, task)
methods.description: Constructs a concise, read-only string of engineer comments, including current reasons and recent historical reasons, for a given task.

ctags.name: TasksPage
ctags.pattern: /^export default function TasksPage({ scopedState, currentUser, routeFilterId }) {$/
